items.title: Ledger Asks Resellers to Halt Sales in Seven Asian Markets
items.summary: The hardware-wallet maker says confirmed incidents remain confined to Southeast Asia, with no indication its systems or direct sales channel were compromised.

items.title: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing
items.summary: The transaction shows how blockchain-based government bonds could help trading firms move collateral faster between settlement and financing.

items.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Bugging Office, Company Says AI Caught Him

items.title: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
items.summary: Tokenized equities have reached nearly $3.3 billion in value as investors embrace round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.
